page.overview:
What is Bigmouth Strikes Again?

TJL Chapter 15 (Name Revealed)|ja_kanji=ビッグマウス・ストライクス・アゲイン|ja_romaji=Biggumausu sutoraikusu agein

Bigmouth Strikes Again (ビッグマウス・ストライクス・アゲイン Biggumausu sutoraikusu agein) is the Stand of Charming Man, featured in The JOJOLands.

Bigmouth Strikes Again is an integrated stand within the user's body, thus having no specific physical appearence, outside of it's ability to turn it's user into sand-like particles.

Bigmouth Strikes Again is an integrated stand that allows it's user to fully control their body and turn it into sand-like particles, similar to Doctor Wu.
